Chocolate Cherry Truffle
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 11, 2009 - 12:38am

Ingredients




2 boxes instant chocolate pudding
1 can cherry pie filling
Milk
Whip cream

Preparation

1 Mix instant pudding as directed on box. Pour cherry pie filling in a glass bowl. Pour pudding over cherries on top of pudding. Spread thawed whip cream over pudding. chill in refrigerator for at least 1 hour. You have a great dessert for a very low cost.
